2026-11-18: 「玩家點擊釋放，做成一個技能卡片三張手牌在手中的樣子，然後玩家可以把它往上提以後丟出去的樣子」 (who casts: the player)

rules.cards: 20: four basic (cheer, first aid, focus, cover) and four for each talent line (hunter: stun shot, weak mark, smoke, snare; breeder: nutrient, calm, vitality, guts; commander: charge, crit drill, link, awaken; trader: bounty, sync, probe, lucky)
rules.owned: the four basic cards always; each talent line gives its four at 3, 9, 15 and 22 points spent in it; nothing is saved (worked out from the talent state)
rules.hand: drawn at the start of each battle from the owned cards, no repeats, with the product random function: Free Battle and Practice 3; title matches and tournaments 1 at title rank 0-2, 2 at 3-5, 3 from 6; password, link, online and the tutorial none
rules.pacing: the first card can be played 3 s into the fight, one more every 6 s (3, 9, 15 s): a free battle measured from the normal entry ended in about 13 s, so the plan's 10 s / 15 s would leave cards unplayable
rules.cast: the player throws a card (drag up past 56 px, or tap to lift and tap again); each card once per battle
rules.effects: applied after the native battle step, where the taxonomy's regeneration and the burst already write HP: HP, TP (metricLimit), the decision cooldown (field28) and the status code; damage and critical bonuses ride the runtime's scaling chain after the taxonomy and the burst; the critical bonus is never negative (the original resolver refuses one), so the plan's 干擾煙幕 (foes' crit -10) became foes' TP -30%
rules.rewards: the trader's four pay only in a won settled owned-party match: Bits +20% of the purse, Sync EXP +25%, crystals +30, a 30% chance of one gachapon ticket
rules.notChanged: native individual fields, the gachapon odds, password and link battles, every parity fixture and replay (no hand, no effect)

art: art:ui:skill-cards:r1: 20 card faces drawn by Codex from a CLI brief (ORIGINAL_GENERATED, assets/production/ui/skill-cards-r1, 128 px WebP); a face that cannot load falls back to a drawn gem
